$ prep --help
--- stdout
usage: prep [-h]
            {brief,research,facts,doctor,hook,pick,run,one,conduct,resume,status,stop,check,message,finish,publish,last,approve} ...

prep — the prep run: businesses researched, built and drafted on Taylor's word (plan
~/projects/plans/28-prep-run.md, ROADMAP B64–B67). This file is born with B65, the research half:

positional arguments:
  {brief,research,facts,doctor,hook,pick,run,one,conduct,resume,status,stop,check,message,finish,publish,last,approve}
    brief               the packet for one business
    research            one Sonnet session a business → facts.json
    facts               facts lint FILE
    doctor              the login, the models, the census, the key
    hook                ==SUPPRESS==
    pick                the night's businesses by fit, plus a reserve (spends
                        nothing)
    run                 the whole night: pick, research, build, judge, batch,
                        finish
    one                 one named business through the whole run (Taylor's
                        `build`)
    conduct             ==SUPPRESS==
    resume              pick a stopped or killed run up where it was
    status              every business's stage, the usage by stage, the marker
    stop                stop the conductor and its sessions (resume carries
                        on)
    check               the seven gates over one business's directory →
                        check.json
    message             the channel, the link, the frame filled, the lint
    finish              the gates again, the publish, the hold, the outline,
                        notify
    publish             retry a failed publish, then the rest of finish
    last                reprint the outline (--html writes one page)
    approve             Taylor's word on templates/prep/message.md

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
--- stderr
--- exit 0
